description: Tells the Discord channel ${team_channel} each time the server's AutoMod acts: on whom, by which rule and what it did. What the member wrote is not repeated.

text.text: AutoMod acted ({{ trigger.event.payload.action }}) on <@{{ trigger.event.payload.member_id }}> by rule {{ trigger.event.payload.rule_id }}{{ trigger.event.payload.channel == '' ? '' : ' in #' + trigger.event.payload.channel }}.
